content.text: Section 19 is comprehensive; no redline needed.

input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables materially conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, and Hosted Services conform throughout the subscription term — better than a fixed 12-month software period (19.2). Compliance with Applicable Law and a no-malicious-code warranty are included (19.3). The remedy is real: prompt re-performance, repair or replacement, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, and it is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims (19.4). The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty. Nothing to redline; Section 6 acceptance and Section 3 service levels are addressed under their own rules.
